results.title: The Walk
results.overview: Kevin has a terrible, horrible, no good, very bad day.

results.title: BOY FIGHTER
results.overview: As a father prepares to confront the greatest tragedy of his life, memories of his past as a bare-knuckle street fighter resurface-- forcing him to reckon with how this shaped the destiny of his young son. Woven between past and present, Boyfighter reveals a legacy of violence; and a fragile search for hope among the ashes.

results.title: The Ribbon
results.overview: She's just a regular teen who definitely ISN'T headless, if that's what you're wondering.

results.title: Loss
results.overview: Amy is having the worst day of her life. Her 16-year-old daughter, Emma, is finally undergoing a heart transplant after waiting over two years. As Emma fights for her life, Amy sits alone in the hospital waiting room, overwhelmed by fear, exhaustion, and a deep anger towards God. She tries to pray but can’t find the words, consumed by rage at the unfairness of it all.

results.title: Lucky Lu
results.overview: A delivery driver in New York City discovers his e-bike has been stolen. With his family en route after many years apart, Lu must contend with a community that has turned its back on him while he tries to replace the only thing promising to keep his family afloat.

results.title: Mary Oliver: Saved by the Beauty of the World
results.original_title: Mary Oliver: Saved by the Beauty of the World
results.overview: From a lonely childhood to literary fame, her life was shaped by devotion to nature, paying attention, and the long journey toward learning to love and to be loved.  If poetry had a pop icon, Mary Oliver would be it.

results.title: Dans mon cœur plaintif es entrée
results.original_title: Dans mon cœur plaintif es entrée

results.title: The Shadow
results.overview: After committing a crime, Santiago and his brother take refuge in an isolated house, where they hold a woman hostage and encounter other unsettling inhabitants. What seemed like a hiding place soon turns into a labyrinth of darkness.

results.title: Enigma
results.overview: Natalie and Miles fall into an unusual dream in a dark room.

results.title: Canelé
results.overview: Canelé is a playful comedy about pregnancy cravings, competition, and the small battles we fight before life shows us the bigger picture. When a devoted but exhausted father-to-be sets out to secure a single pastry for his very pregnant wife, he's pulled into an absurd, high-stakes race against his equally stubborn neighbor. What begins as a simple errand spirals into sabotage, rivalry, and sheer chaos-until a sudden twist reminds everyone what truly matters.

results.title: Uyir
results.overview: SI Ajeeb, a probationary officer posted in a Kerala town, investigates the mysterious death of an unidentified woman whose decomposed body is found in a well. Despite a lack of evidence and official support, he relentlessly pursues the truth with the help of ASI Joy while battling his own psychological struggles. Inspired by true events, the film follows his quest for justice in a case that changes his life forever.

results.title: KILL KILL BANG BANG
results.overview: A restaurant worker just wants to finish her shift and go home, but the night has other plans for her.

results.title: Emil and the Detectives
results.overview: Emil is spending his summer vacation with his grandmother in Berlin. But on the train there, he is robbed by the ruthless con artist Max Grundeis and a wild adventure begins! Together with his friends Pony, Gustav, Dienstag, Anh, and Jason, Emil sets off in pursuit and embarks on a fast-paced detective hunt across Berlin.

results.title: Painted Sharks
results.overview: Carrying the blame for her mother’s pain, Ricki searches for a way out of an abusive family relationship. She and her younger sister face a dilemma no child should… how to get rid of their father?

results.title: ONE OK ROCK DETOX JAPAN TOUR AT NISSAN STADIUM 2025 IN CINEMAS
results.original_title: ONE OK ROCK DETOX JAPAN TOUR AT NISSAN STADIUM 2025 IN CINEMAS
results.overview: ONE OK ROCK DETOX JAPAN TOUR 2025 AT NISSAN STADIUM IN CINEMAS unleashes the raw pulse of a career-defining night—documenting the band's commanding takeover of Japan's iconic Nissan Stadium—where thunderous riffs, soaring vocals, and 70,000 voices collide into something electric, forging an unbreakable bond between the band and their worldwide legion of fans.

results.title: Voidance
results.overview: To join the elite ATIC Guard, Alana Toro must pass one final test: enter a simulation, prevent a terrorist attack, and prove her loyalty. Every mistake resets the clock. Every death disappears - except in her memory, where the weight keeps building. The more Alana learns, the more she begins to question the organisation she fought so hard to join.

results.title: The Echo Chamber
results.overview: Leo and Ava chase each other—coming close, drifting apart, and searching for their way back. They cannot let go, nor break free. Through the rooms, Ava’s voice echoes across time, carrying to the surface what endures—and what can no longer be held back.

results.title: The Interned
results.overview: During an office Halloween party, an intern accidentally unleashes a demon that possesses her coworkers, forcing her to fight for survival - and a shot at a full time job.

results.title: Trans: positions
results.overview: Simon Coutu explores the rise of transphobia and the weaponization of transgender identity in political and media discourse. Meeting with members of the trans community and with right-wing organizers who denounce what they call “gender ideology,” he seeks to understand how transgender identity has become such a polarizing issue in Québec.
